photographyStyle.mood: Warm, intimate, editorial luxury. Think Architectural Digest meets Kinfolk, with Indian soul.
photographyStyle.lighting: Natural daylight preferred. Golden hour for lifestyle. Soft diffused window light for flat-lays. No harsh studio lighting. No flash.
photographyStyle.composition: Negative space is your friend. Rule of thirds. 40% empty space minimum in feed posts. Overhead for flat-lays. Eye-level for lifestyle.
photographyStyle.colorPalette: Dominant: creams, warm whites, sandstone. Accents: amber, terracotta, dark wood, muted sage green. Occasional: brass/gold metallic. Never: neon, bright white, cool blue.
photographyStyle.tone: Aspirational but warm. Luxurious but never cold. Indian heritage but modern. Serene but alive.

reels.hookRule: First 2 seconds must grab attention: text overlay, pattern interrupt, or visual surprise. Reels without a 2-second hook lose 70% of viewers.

types.name: Clean Burn Test

types.name: ASMR Unboxing
types.format: No talking. No music. Only sounds: kraft paper rustle → box opening → incense reveal → match strike → gentle blow → smoke swirl. Close-up macro. End: quiet logo fade.

universalGuidelines.materials: Kraft paper (FSC-certified, 300–350 GSM) for outer box. Soy-based ink printing. Natural jute twine for bundling. No plastic, no lamination, no cellophane.
universalGuidelines.construction: Magnetic flap closure (no glue). Tear-away top transforms box into display stand. Slide-out inner tray catches ash during use — dual utility.
universalGuidelines.printing: 1–2 color screen print or digital print. Amber (#B45309) + dark brown (#1C1917) on kraft. Minimalist — brand name + product name + key USP only on front.
universalGuidelines.interior: Inner lid: artisan profile printed — 'Handcrafted by [Name] in [City]. She has been with SEWA for [X] years.' Rotate 10 profiles across production batches.
universalGuidelines.size: Compact. No oversized boxes. Box height = product height + 5mm padding only.
universalGuidelines.finishing: Matte finish. No gloss. No foil (except Diwali special edition — brass/gold foil). Embossed SEWA logo on lid.
sustainabilityFeatures: Seed-paper belly band: remove, soak in water, plant — grows Tulsi or Basil
Box base perforation: tear to create incense ash tray
QR code on base: scan to see artisan video (30-second message)
100% compostable within 90 days in home compost
